# uptimekuma_notification_webhook (Resource)

Webhook notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_webhook" "example" {
  name                 = "Generic Webhook Notification"
  webhook_url          = "https://webhooks.example.com/uptime-kuma"
  webhook_content_type = "json"
  is_active            = true
  is_default           = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_webhook" "with_headers" {
  name                 = "Webhook with Auth"
  webhook_url          = "https://webhooks.example.com/uptime-kuma"
  webhook_content_type = "json"
  webhook_additional_headers = {
    "Authorization"   = "Bearer token123"
    "X-Custom-Header" = "value"
  }
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: webhook_url_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change webhook_url_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_webhook" "write_only" {
  name = "Webhook with a write-only secret"

  webhook_content_type = "json"

  webhook_url_wo         = "https://webhooks.example.com/uptime-kuma"
  webhook_url_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `webhook_additional_headers` (Map of String) Additional HTTP headers to send with the webhook request (e.g., Authorization headers)
- `webhook_content_type` (String) Content type for the webhook payload. Supported values: `json`, `form-data`, `custom`. Defaults to `json`
- `webhook_custom_body` (String) Custom JSON body template (only used when webhook_content_type is `custom`). Supports template variables like `{{ msg }}` and `{{ monitorJSON['name'] }}`
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Webhook endpoint URL. Stored in state; use `webhook_url_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `webhook_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Webhook URL, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `webhook_url`; requires `webhook_url_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `webhook_url_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `webhook_url` until the next apply with `webhook_url_wo` set removes it from state.
- `webhook_url_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `webhook_url_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `webhook_url_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
